MrBeast will feature Gemini, Google Health, and the Fitbit Air in upcoming videos as part of a [multi-year partnership with Google](https://blog.google/company-news/inside-google/company-announcements/mrbeast-gemini-google-health/). title: (No AI) OpenAI accused of ‘aiding and abetting’ Tumbler Ridge mass shooting in dozens of new lawsuits
author: Emma Roth
content:
![A photo of a memorial at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School in Canada](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/gettyimages-2261008686.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

OpenAI and its CEO Sam Altman are facing 30 new lawsuits that accuse them of providing "substantial assistance and encouragement" to the suspect in Canada's Tumbler Ridge school shooting, as reported [earlier by _TechCrunch_](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/02/openai-faces-30-more-lawsuits-tied-to-tumbler-ridge-shooting/). The new wave of lawsuits was [filed in a California federal court](https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/28594890-rushlow-v-openai/) on Wednesday by the students, teachers, and the principal in the school at the time of the shooting.

Similar to the [lawsuits filed by Tumbler Ridge victims' families](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/920479/tumbler-ridge-chagpt-openai-lawsuit) in April, these lawsuits claim OpenAI failed to take action after its automated review system flagged conversations that the alleged shooter, Jesse Van Rootselaar, had with ChatGPT about gun vio …
